entries.5931ea0e7fd791d4: In May 2026 the company formulated a medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended March 2027 to March 2029), and its basic strategy is the “Passing Record Strategy,” which starts from thorough practice of its educational philosophy “Raising children who truly commit” and aims to achieve academic improvement and admission to target schools. The three pillars of the business strategy are further growth of standard schools, maximizing customer lifetime value by strengthening the university entrance and individual tutoring divisions, and expanding inorganic growth areas.
entries.5c40a5078715d1d4: This is the single segment of a group composed of the company and six consolidated subsidiaries with 100% ownership, seven companies in total. Consolidated number of employees is 1,109 (as of March 31, 2026). The company operates directly managed school buildings in the Tokyo metropolitan area (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba and Ibaraki prefectures), while its subsidiaries operate Noda Kuruze, a prep school specializing in medicine, dentistry and pharmacy; QUARD (Kuōdo) in Chiba Prefecture; the early childhood class Venture School Sun Kids; and school buildings for Japanese children in London and New York. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥37,658 million.
